question.prompt: Classify \(-2, 0, 3.5, -1/3, 7\) as positive numbers, 0, or negative numbers. (Write the numbers in each of the three categories.)

solutions.explanation: Numbers greater than 0 are positive: 3.5, 7; the number equal to 0 is 0; numbers less than 0 are negative: \(-2, -1/3\).
solutions.title: Classification by sign
